message.content: As the context length grew, the model’s ability to retain and accurately reference earlier information deteriorated, leading to a noticeable decline in coherence and factual consistency. The increased token count strained the attention mechanism, causing it to allocate less weight to distant tokens and making it harder for the model to maintain a stable understanding of the overall narrative. Consequently, the generated responses became more fragmented, with a higher likelihood of hallucinations and inconsistencies, reflecting the model’s reduced capacity to process and integrate long sequences of text effectively.
